sanskrit: brāhmaṇyāṃ vṛṣalāj jātaṃ pitar vedayatīha mām amānuṣī gardabhīyaṃ tasmāt tapsye tapo mahat
english: Father, this she-donkey, no mere beast but more than human, declares me born of a brāhmaṇa woman by a man of the lowest sort; therefore I shall practice a mighty austerity.

sanskrit: evam uktvā sa pitaraṃ pratasthe kṛtaniścayaḥ tato gatvā mahāraṇyam atapyata mahat tapaḥ
english: Having spoken thus to his father, his resolve fixed, he set out; and going to the great forest, he practiced a mighty austerity.

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃtāpayām āsa vibudhāṃs tapasānvitaḥ mataṅgaḥ susukhaṃ prepsuḥ sthānaṃ sucaritād api
english: Then Mataṅga, endowed with austerity, scorched the gods with the heat of his penance, seeking to win a blissful station beyond even that gained by right conduct.

sanskrit: taṃ tathā tapasā yuktam uvāca harivāhanaḥ mataṅga tapyase kiṃ tvaṃ bhogān utsṛjya mānuṣān
english: To him, thus engaged in austerity, the bearer of the bay steeds said: "Mataṅga, why do you mortify yourself, casting aside the pleasures of men?"

sanskrit: varaṃ dadāni te hanta vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ yad icchasi yac cāpy avāpyam anyat te sarvaṃ prabrūhi māciram
english: "Come, I grant you a boon; choose whatever you desire. And whatever else may be obtained, declare it all to me without delay."

sanskrit: mataṅga uvāca brāhmaṇyaṃ kāmayāno 'ham idam ārabdhavāṃs tapaḥ gaccheyaṃ tad avāpyeha vara eṣa vṛto mayā
english: Mataṅga said: "Longing for brāhmaṇahood, I have undertaken this austerity. May I attain it and reach that state here; this is the boon I have chosen."

sanskrit: etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ tam uvāca puraṃdaraḥ brāhmaṇyaṃ prārthayānas tvam aprāpyam akṛtātmabhiḥ
english: Hearing these words, Puraṃdara said to him: "You crave brāhmaṇahood, which is unattainable by those whose selves are unperfected."

sanskrit: śreṣṭhaṃ yat sarvabhūteṣu tapo yan nātivartate tadagryaṃ prārthayānas tvam acirād vinaśiṣyasi
english: "Craving that supreme thing, the foremost among all beings, which no austerity can surpass, you will soon perish."

sanskrit: devatāsuramartyeṣu yat pavitraṃ paraṃ smṛtam caṇḍālayonau jātena na tat prāpyaṃ kathaṃ cana
english: "That which is held the highest purity among gods, asuras, and mortals can in no way be attained by one born in the womb of a caṇḍāla."

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca evam ukto mataṅgas tu saṃśitātmā yatavrataḥ atiṣṭhad ekapādena varṣāṇāṃ śatam acyuta
english: Bhīṣma said: Thus addressed, Mataṅga, his soul resolute and his vows controlled, stood upon one foot for a hundred years, O unfaltering one.

sanskrit: tam uvāca tataḥ śakraḥ punar eva mahāyaśāḥ mataṅga paramaṃ sthānaṃ prārthayann atidurlabham
english: Then the greatly renowned Śakra spoke to him once again: "Mataṅga, you seek that highest station, which is most hard to win."

sanskrit: mā kṛthāḥ sāhasaṃ putra naiṣa dharmapathas tava aprāpyaṃ prārthayāno hi nacirād vinaśiṣyasi
english: "Do not act so rashly, my son; this is not the path of dharma for you. Craving what cannot be attained, you will soon perish."

sanskrit: mataṅga paramaṃ sthānaṃ vāryamāṇo mayā sakṛt cikīrṣasy eva tapasā sarvathā na bhaviṣyasi
english: "Mataṅga, though restrained by me once, you still strive by austerity for the highest station; by no means will you attain it."

sanskrit: tiryagyonigataḥ sarvo mānuṣyaṃ yadi gacchati sa jāyate pulkaso vā caṇḍālo vā kadā cana
english: "If any creature fallen into the womb of beasts comes at last to human birth, it is born now and then as a pulkasa or a caṇḍāla."

sanskrit: puṃścalaḥ pāpayonir vā yaḥ kaś cid iha lakṣyate sa tasyām eva suciraṃ mataṅga parivartate
english: "Whoever here is marked as a son of a wanton woman or of a sinful womb, Mataṅga, revolves in that very condition for a very long time."

sanskrit: tato daśaguṇe kāle labhate śūdratām api śūdrayonāv api tato bahuśaḥ parivartate
english: "Then, after a tenfold span of time, he attains even the state of a śūdra; and in the śūdra womb thereafter he revolves many times."

sanskrit: tatas triṃśad guṇe kāle labhate vaiśyatām api vaiśyatāyāṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate
english: "Then, after a thirtyfold span of time, he attains even the state of a vaiśya; and in that vaiśya condition he revolves for a long time."

sanskrit: tataḥ ṣaṣṭiguṇe kāle rājanyo nāma jāyate rājanyatve ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate
english: "Then, after a sixtyfold span of time, he is born one called a rājanya; and in that kṣatriya estate he revolves for a long time."

sanskrit: tataḥ ṣaṣṭiguṇe kāle labhate brahmabandhutām brahmabandhuś ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate
english: "Then, after a sixtyfold span of time, he attains kinship with brāhmaṇas; and as such a brahma-kinsman he revolves for a long time."

sanskrit: tatas tu dviśate kāle labhate kāṇḍapṛṣṭhatām kāṇḍapṛṣṭhaś ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate
english: "Then, after twice a hundred such spans, he attains the state of a kāṇḍapṛṣṭha; and as a kāṇḍapṛṣṭha he revolves for a long time."

sanskrit: tatas tu triśate kāle labhate dvijatām api tāṃ ca prāpya ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate
english: "Then, after thrice a hundred such spans, he attains even the state of a twice-born; and having reached it, he revolves there for a long time."

sanskrit: tataś catuḥśate kāle śrotriyo nāma jāyate śrotriyatve ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate
english: "Then, after four hundred such spans, he is born one called a śrotriya, learned in the Veda; and in that śrotriya estate he revolves for a long time."

sanskrit: tadaiva krodhaharṣau ca kāmadveṣau ca putraka atimānātivādau tam āviśanti dvijādhamam
english: "And even then anger and elation, desire and hatred, excessive pride and harsh speech, my son, enter that lowest of the twice-born."

sanskrit: tāṃś cej jayati śatrūn sa tadā prāpnoti sadgatim atha te vai jayanty enaṃ tālāgrād iva pātyate
english: "If he conquers those enemies, he then attains the good path; but if they conquer him, he is cast down as from the top of a palm tree."

sanskrit: mataṅga saṃpradhāryaitad yad ahaṃ tvām acūcudam vṛṇīṣva kāmam anyaṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ hi sudurlabham
english: "Mataṅga, having weighed this, on account of which I have urged you, choose some other desire; for brāhmaṇahood is very hard to win."

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca evam ukto mataṅgas tu bhṛśaṃ śokaparāyaṇaḥ atiṣṭhata gayāṃ gatvā so 'ṅguṣṭhena śataṃ samāḥ
english: Bhīṣma said: Thus addressed, Mataṅga, sunk deep in grief, went to Gayā and stood there poised upon his great toe for a hundred years.

sanskrit: suduṣkaraṃ vahan yogaṃ kṛśo dhamanisaṃtataḥ tvagasthibhūto dharmātmā sa papāteti naḥ śrutam
english: Sustaining a most difficult discipline, grown gaunt with his veins standing forth, reduced to skin and bone, that righteous soul fell down at last—so we have heard.

sanskrit: taṃ patantam abhidrutya parijagrāha vāsavaḥ varāṇām īśvaro dātā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
english: As he fell, Vāsava rushed forward and caught him—the lord and bestower of boons, devoted to the welfare of all beings.

sanskrit: śakra uvāca mataṅga brāhmaṇatvaṃ te saṃvṛtaṃ paripanthibhiḥ pūjayan sukham āpnoti duḥkham āpnoty apūjayan
english: Śakra said: "Mataṅga, your attaining of brāhmaṇahood is hedged about by obstacles. He who honors the brāhmaṇa wins happiness; he who fails to honor him wins sorrow."

sanskrit: brāhmaṇe sarvabhūtānāṃ yogakṣemaḥ samāhitaḥ brāhmaṇebhyo 'nutṛpyanti pitaro devatās tathā
english: "In the brāhmaṇa the welfare and security of all beings rests secure; through brāhmaṇas the ancestors and the gods alike are satisfied."

sanskrit: brāhmaṇaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ mataṅga para ucyate brāhmaṇaḥ kurute tad dhi yathā yad yac ca vāñchati
english: "The brāhmaṇa, Mataṅga, is declared the highest of all beings; for the brāhmaṇa accomplishes whatever and however he wishes."

sanskrit: bahvīs tu saṃsaran yonīr jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ paryāye tāta kasmiṃś cid brāhmaṇyam iha vindati
english: "Passing through many wombs, being born again and again, only at some turn in the round, my son, does one here come upon brāhmaṇahood."

sanskrit: mataṅga uvāca kiṃ māṃ tudasi duḥkhārtaṃ mṛtaṃ mārayase ca mām taṃ tu śocāmi yo labdhvā brāhmaṇyaṃ na bubhūṣate
english: Mataṅga said: "Why do you torment me, stricken with grief, and slay me who am already dead? But I grieve for that man who, having gained brāhmaṇahood, cares not to be a brāhmaṇa."

sanskrit: brāhmaṇyaṃ yadi duṣprāpaṃ tribhir varṇaiḥ śatakrato sudurlabhaṃ tadāvāpya nānutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ
english: "If brāhmaṇahood is hard to win for the three other varṇas, O lord of a hundred sacrifices, yet having gained that thing so hard to win, men do not live up to it."

sanskrit: yaḥ pāpebhyaḥ pāpatamas teṣām adhama eva saḥ brāhmaṇyaṃ yo 'vajānīte dhanaṃ labdhveva durlabham
english: "He is the most sinful of the sinful, the basest among them, who slights his brāhmaṇahood as a man might slight a hard-won treasure he has gained."

sanskrit: duṣprāpaṃ khalu vipratvaṃ prāptaṃ duranupālanam duravāpam avāpyaitan nānutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ
english: "Hard indeed to attain is the brāhmaṇa's estate, and once attained, hard to maintain; yet having won this thing so hard to win, men do not live up to it."

sanskrit: ekārāmo hy ahaṃ śakra nirdvaṃdvo niṣparigrahaḥ ahiṃsādamadānasthaḥ kathaṃ nārhāmi vipratām
english: "I delight in solitude, O Śakra, free from the pairs of opposites, owning nothing, established in non-violence, self-restraint, and giving—how am I not worthy of the brāhmaṇa's estate?"

sanskrit: yathākāmavihārī syāṃ kāmarūpī vihaṃgamaḥ brahmakṣatrāvirodhena pūjāṃ ca prāpnuyām aham yathā mamākṣayā kīrtir bhavec cāpi puraṃdara
english: "Grant then that I may roam at will, a bird that takes what form it wishes; that I may receive honor without offense to brāhmaṇa or kṣatriya; and that my fame, O Puraṃdara, may become imperishable."

sanskrit: indra uvāca chandodeva iti khyātaḥ strīṇāṃ pūjyo bhaviṣyasi
english: Indra said: "Renowned as Chandodeva, you shall become an object of worship among women."

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca evaṃ tasmai varaṃ dattvā vāsavo 'ntaradhīyata prāṇāṃs tyaktvā mataṅgo 'pi prāpa tat sthānam uttamam
english: Bhīṣma said: Having granted him this boon, Vāsava vanished; and Mataṅga too, giving up his life-breaths, attained that highest station.

sanskrit: evam etat paraṃ sthānaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ nāma bhārata tac ca duṣprāpam iha vai mahendravacanaṃ yathā
english: So this highest station, called brāhmaṇahood, O Bhārata, is hard to win in this world, even as the words of great Indra declared.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca śrutaṃ me mahad ākhyānam etat kurukulodvaha suduṣprāpaṃ bravīṣi tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ vadatāṃ vara
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: I have heard this great tale, O upholder of the Kuru line; you declare brāhmaṇahood most hard to win, O best of speakers.

sanskrit: viśvāmitreṇa ca purā brāhmaṇyaṃ prāptam ity uta śrūyate vadase tac ca duṣprāpam iti sattama
english: Yet it is heard that long ago Viśvāmitra attained brāhmaṇahood; and still you say it is hard to win, O most virtuous one.

sanskrit: vītahavyaś ca rājarṣiḥ śruto me vipratāṃ gataḥ tad eva tāvad gāṅgeya śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ vibho
english: And I have heard that the royal sage Vītahavya passed into the brāhmaṇa's estate; that very story, son of Gaṅgā, I wish to hear, O mighty one.

sanskrit: sa kena karmaṇā prāpto brāhmaṇyaṃ rājasattama vareṇa tapasā vāpi tan me vyākhyātum arhati
english: By what deed did he attain brāhmaṇahood, O best of kings—by a boon, or by austerity? That you should be pleased to explain to me.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca śṛṇu rājan yathā rājā vītahavyo mahāyaśāḥ kṣatriyaḥ san punaḥ prāpto brāhmaṇyaṃ lokasatkṛtam
english: Bhīṣma said: Hear, O king, how the greatly renowned king Vītahavya, though a kṣatriya, came to attain the brāhmaṇahood that the world reveres.

sanskrit: manor mahātmanas tāta prajādharmeṇa śāsataḥ babhūva putro dharmātmā śaryātir iti viśrutaḥ
english: Of the great-souled Manu, who ruled by the dharma of a guardian of his people, there was a righteous son, renowned by the name of Śaryāti.

sanskrit: tasyānvavāye dvau rājan rājānau saṃbabhūvatuḥ hehayas tālajaṅghaś ca vatseṣu jayatāṃ vara
english: In his line, O king, there arose two kings, Hehaya and Tālajaṅgha, among the Vatsas, O best of the victorious.

sanskrit: hehayasya tu putrāṇāṃ daśasu strīṣu bhārata śataṃ babhūva prakhyātaṃ śūrāṇām anivartinām
english: Of Hehaya's sons by ten wives, O Bhārata, there came to be a famed hundred, heroes who never turned back in battle.

sanskrit: tulyarūpaprabhāvāṇāṃ viduṣāṃ yuddhaśālinām dhanurvede ca vede ca sarvatraiva kṛtaśramāḥ
english: Equal in form and power, learned and skilled in war, they had labored diligently in every branch of the science of archery and of the Veda.

sanskrit: kāśiṣv api nṛpo rājan divodāsapitāmahaḥ haryaśva iti vikhyāto babhūva jayatāṃ varaḥ
english: Among the Kāśis too, O king, there was a ruler, the grandfather of Divodāsa, renowned as Haryaśva, best of the victorious.

sanskrit: sa vītahavyadāyādair āgatya puruṣarṣabha gaṅgāyamunayor madhye saṃgrāme vinipātitaḥ
english: The heirs of Vītahavya came against him, O bull among men, and in the land between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā he was struck down in battle.

sanskrit: taṃ tu hatvā naravaraṃ hehayās te mahārathāḥ pratijagmuḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ vatsānām akutobhayāḥ
english: Having slain that finest of men, those Hehaya great chariot-warriors returned, free from all fear, to the lovely city of the Vatsas.

sanskrit: haryaśvasya tu dāyādaḥ kāśirājo 'bhyaṣicyata sudevo devasaṃkāśaḥ sākṣād dharma ivāparaḥ
english: Then Haryaśva's heir Sudeva, godlike in his splendor, like Dharma himself made manifest, was consecrated king of Kāśi.

sanskrit: sa pālayann eva mahīṃ dharmātmā kāśinandanaḥ tair vītahavyair āgatya yudhi sarvair vinirjitaḥ
english: As the righteous joy of the Kāśis was ruling the earth, those sons of Vītahavya came once more and in battle utterly defeated him.

sanskrit: tam apy ājau vinirjitya pratijagmur yathāgatam saudevis tv atha kāśīśo divodāso 'bhyaṣicyata
english: Having defeated him too in the fray, they returned as they had come; and then Sudeva's son Divodāsa was consecrated lord of Kāśi.

sanskrit: divodāsas tu vijñāya vīryaṃ teṣāṃ mahātmanām vārāṇasīṃ mahātejā nirmame śakraśāsanāt
english: But Divodāsa, knowing well the prowess of those great-souled foes, in his great splendor built the city of Vārāṇasī at Śakra's command.

sanskrit: viprakṣatriyasaṃbādhāṃ vaiśyaśūdrasamākulām naikadravyoccayavatīṃ samṛddhavipaṇāpaṇām
english: It was thronged with brāhmaṇas and kṣatriyas, teeming with vaiśyas and śūdras, heaped with goods of every kind, rich in its markets and its stalls.

sanskrit: gaṅgāyā uttare kūle vaprānte rājasattama gomatyā dakṣiṇe caiva śakrasyevāmarāvatīm
english: On the northern bank of the Gaṅgā, by the edge of the rampart, O best of kings, and on the southern side of the Gomatī—like Śakra's own Amarāvatī.

sanskrit: tatra taṃ rājaśārdūlaṃ nivasantaṃ mahīpatim āgatya hehayā bhūyaḥ paryadhāvanta bhārata
english: There, as that tiger among kings, the lord of the earth, was dwelling, the Hehayas came once again and assailed him on every side, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: sa niṣpatya dadau yuddhaṃ tebhyo rājā mahābalaḥ devāsurasamaṃ ghoraṃ divodāso mahādyutiḥ
english: That mighty king of great radiance, Divodāsa, sallied forth and gave them battle, dreadful as the clash of gods and asuras.

sanskrit: sa tu yuddhe mahārāja dinānāṃ daśatīr daśa hatavāhanabhūyiṣṭhas tato dainyam upāgamat
english: In that battle, O great king, for a thousand days, with the most of his mounts slain, he was at last brought to wretchedness.

sanskrit: hatayodhas tato rājan kṣīṇakośaś ca bhūmipaḥ divodāsaḥ purīṃ hitvā palāyanaparo 'bhavat
english: His warriors slain and his treasury drained, O king, the lord of the earth Divodāsa abandoned his city and gave himself over to flight.

sanskrit: sa tv āśramam upāgamya bharadvājasya dhīmataḥ jagāma śaraṇaṃ rājā kṛtāñjalir ariṃdama
english: Coming to the hermitage of the wise Bharadvāja, the king sought refuge with folded hands, O subduer of foes.

sanskrit: rājovāca bhagavan vaitahavyair me yuddhe vaṃśaḥ praṇāśitaḥ aham ekaḥ paridyūno bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
english: The king said: "Holy one, the sons of Vītahavya have destroyed my line in battle; I alone, utterly afflicted, have come to you for refuge."

sanskrit: śiṣyasnehena bhagavan sa māṃ rakṣitum arhasi niḥśeṣo hi kṛto vaṃśo mama taiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ
english: "By your affection for a pupil, holy one, you ought to protect me; for my line has been left without remnant by those doers of evil deeds."

sanskrit: tam uvāca mahābhāgo bharadvājaḥ pratāpavān na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyaṃ saudeva vyetu te bhayam
english: To him the blessed and mighty Bharadvāja said: "Fear not, fear not, son of Sudeva; let your dread depart."

sanskrit: aham iṣṭiṃ karomy adya putrārthaṃ te viśāṃ pate vaitahavyasahasrāṇi yathā tvaṃ prasahiṣyasi
english: "This very day I shall perform a sacrifice for a son for you, O lord of the people, that you may overcome the thousands of Vītahavya's kin."

sanskrit: tata iṣṭiṃ cakārarṣis tasya vai putrakāmikīm athāsya tanayo jajñe pratardana iti śrutaḥ
english: Then the sage performed for him that sacrifice for the gaining of a son; and there was born to him a boy renowned as Pratardana.

sanskrit: sa jātamātro vavṛdhe samāḥ sadyas trayodaśa vedaṃ cādhijage kṛtsnaṃ dhanurvedaṃ ca bhārata
english: No sooner was he born than he grew, on the instant, to a youth of thirteen years, and mastered the whole Veda and the science of archery, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: yogena ca samāviṣṭo bharadvājena dhīmatā tejo laukyaṃ sa saṃgṛhya tasmin deśe samāviśat
english: Pervaded by the yoga of the wise Bharadvāja, he gathered into himself the splendor of the world and entered into that prince.

sanskrit: tataḥ sa kavacī dhanvī bāṇī dīpta ivānalaḥ prayayau sa dhanur dhunvan vivarṣur iva toyadaḥ
english: Then, mailed, bow in hand and arrows ready, blazing like fire, he marched forth, brandishing his bow like a rain-cloud about to pour.

sanskrit: taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ harṣaṃ sudevatanayo yayau mene ca manasā dagdhān vaitahavyān sa pārthivaḥ
english: Beholding him, Sudeva's son was filled with the highest joy, and that king reckoned in his mind that the sons of Vītahavya were already consumed.

sanskrit: tatas taṃ yauvarājyena sthāpayitvā pratardanam kṛtakṛtyaṃ tadātmānaṃ sa rājā abhyanandata
english: Then, having installed Pratardana in the office of heir-apparent, the king rejoiced, accounting himself to have accomplished his purpose.

sanskrit: tatas tu vaitahavyānāṃ vadhāya sa mahīpatiḥ putraṃ prasthāpayām āsa pratardanam ariṃdamam
english: Then for the slaying of the sons of Vītahavya that lord of the earth sent forth his son, Pratardana, the subduer of foes.

sanskrit: sarathaḥ sa tu saṃtīrya gaṅgām āśu parākramī prayayau vītahavyānāṃ purīṃ parapuraṃjayaḥ
english: Swiftly that valiant one, conqueror of hostile cities, crossed the Gaṅgā with his chariot and marched upon the city of the sons of Vītahavya.

sanskrit: vaitahavyās tu saṃśrutya rathaghoṣaṃ samuddhatam niryayur nagarākārai rathaiḥ pararathārujaiḥ
english: But the sons of Vītahavya, hearing the swelling thunder of his chariot, sallied forth on chariots vast as fortresses, crushers of the chariots of their foes.

sanskrit: niṣkramya te naravyāghrā daṃśitāś citrayodhinaḥ pratardanaṃ samājaghnuḥ śaravarṣair udāyudhāḥ
english: Sallying forth, those tigers among men, mailed and skilled in varied fighting, weapons raised, struck at Pratardana with showers of arrows.

sanskrit: astraiś ca vividhākārai rathaughaiś ca yudhiṣṭhira abhyavarṣanta rājānaṃ himavantam ivāmbudāḥ
english: With missiles of every kind and floods of chariots, O Yudhiṣṭhira, they rained upon the king as rain-clouds upon the Himālaya.

sanskrit: astrair astrāṇi saṃvārya teṣāṃ rājā pratardanaḥ jaghāna tān mahātejā vajrānalasamaiḥ śaraiḥ
english: Warding off their missiles with his own, king Pratardana of great splendor slew them with arrows that were like the thunderbolt and like fire.
